audience: finance teams and founders who bank with Mercury

useCases.title: Check balances across accounts
useCases.text: List the bank accounts with current and available balances, then read the monthly statements of one account.

useCases.title: Review transactions for a period
useCases.text: Search transactions across all accounts by date range or text, then open one transaction for its category and counterparty.

useCases.title: Chase unpaid customer invoices
useCases.text: List the invoice customers and the invoices the organization issued, then open one invoice with its payments.

useCases.title: Track payments waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the send-money requests that still need approval, then read one request with the approvals it requires.

useCases.title: Request a payment for approval
useCases.text: Find a saved recipient, then create a payment request to it. Mercury does not send the money until an admin approves it.
